power: strong fully regular 80-hit plants only; partial-regularity and forward-cipher power unknown

config.relation: within-word T6 raw, no I5 or other maps
config.bin_origin: first eligible pair of each section; include short terminal bin
config.gap: internal inter-hit gaps in eligible-pair order, exposure-adjusted; no cross-section gaps
config.null: independent inhomogeneous Bernoulli site law, conditioned on exactly 80 hits
config.rates: raw-T6 pair marginal by local word position; prior own-doublet q_s fixed, not refitted to sites
config.controls: 4 matched Bernoulli negatives, 4 random-phase systematic evenly-spaced positives
config.caveat: motivated by previous same-data smoothness; not independent replication or a forward-cipher null
